observation: The approved MAST plan uses a NOHARM pilot to choose numerical margins and freeze the complete-run analysis, then describes the complete open epoch as all thirty base-case families. Reusing pilot families in the primary confirmation statistic would let development data influence and then confirm the same decision rule.

implementedNonblockingRepair.pilot: ten outcome-blind families, one per specialty prefix, all eleven variants
implementedNonblockingRepair.officialFullCorpus: all thirty families reported separately as DESCRIPTIVE_OFFICIAL_FULL_OPEN_CORPUS

questionForSupervisor: Should this development/confirmation/full-descriptive separation become the canonical interpretation whenever a benchmark pilot is allowed to tune margins or decision rules before a nominal full-corpus run?

alignment.operational: zero-spend plan remains executable and full-corpus reporting is preserved
alignment.scientific: prevents pilot-influenced decisions from masquerading as untouched confirmation
alignment.release: no inference, external submission, production mutation, or protocol mutation
